My expectation was to have another co-op game to play with friends but expected it to be too corny to want to play with pubbers or solo. I was wrong. 

The game is very approachable and FUN. It is rarely the same experience with a large variety of maps and game types, while allowing various skill levels to all play in the same game. Try it.

*Update-8/19/24*
I've crashed three times today in matches. Not quite sure what the cause is but its pretty random.

*UPDATE* They patched the SPEAR and it is now works. The crashing issues I have only ran into once so far out of 43 hours. If I had to choose between this or CALL OF DIPSH*TS. I would go with this game every time.
Leaving the old review for but will probably delete it if they keep up the improvements.

This game launched at full price and has been plagued with issues since. This last patch is so bad that it is unbearable. I quit and requested for a refund. I was obviously denied but do feel like even 80% of a refund should be allowed. The games nowadays launch pretty janky and the fact we just keep letting them do us like this is astonishing. We paid full price for a completed game that is unplayable. Use the SPEAR and you will disconnect 100% of the time. Infinite loop loading screens, constant crashing, as of now I can maybe play half a match before disconnecting. I feel entitled to a refund just because how bad it is. People should have the right to jump ship if your game doesnt work. Just my two cents and worth just that but my advice to you is don't buy this game and if it is a MUST HAVE. I would wait another year. They patched the SPEAR in this patch because it didn't work the entire game along with a bunch of other broken stuff. The patch that fixed the SPEAR broke the game entirely and now is unplayable. That is just one example. The endless loading screen makes my computers fans hit MAX and just trys to burn out my ram/video card. I literally said to myself if I was to walk away and come back a few hours later my pc would probably be fried.
Run and gun + satire + co-op + utter chaos = a real winner of a game.

I did not jump onto this band wagon quickly. I wish I had. I kept hearing my friends talking about playing this game. I am more of a solo / Campaign player (i.e. I usually suck at online multiplayer games). I also do not care for grinding games, but for some reason Helldivers 2 is just a fun game. I really enjoy playing even with random players. Somehow the developer was able to cultivate a culture of collaboration and team work unlike any other game I have played previously. Another pro to this game is the fact that you can earn the necessary currencies in game. You can purchase war bonds and armors but that can only get you so far to be honest. The largest strategic part to the game you earn the old fashion way by just playing. I definitely recommend the game.

UPDATE: This is pretty much the only game I play now. I enjoy it a lot. I wish I had a squad though. But playing with random players is still awesome. Great community.
